parameters.name: ChildUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the RAM user. You must specify either the RelationId parameter, or the ParentUserId, ChildUserId, and RelationType parameters.

parameters.name: ParentUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You must specify either the RelationId parameter, or the ParentUserId, ChildUserId, and RelationType parameters.

parameters.name: RelationId
parameters.description: The ID of the account association. You must specify either the RelationId parameter, or the ParentUserId, ChildUserId, and RelationType parameters.

parameters.name: RelationType
parameters.description: The relationship type. Only enterprise\_group is supported.

parameters.name: RequestId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the request. This ID is used to troubleshoot issues.
